title: 第23章 四象八卦
content_zh:
原来闵嘉庚知道空手打他不过，趁机拾起断剑用作武器，但怕对方使武器，抢先激他一激。厉宏生何等身份，明知吃亏，哪肯跟他平手对刀，料定他多拿一柄断剑也管不了用，只“哼”了一声，八卦掌中夹着擒拿手，径来抓他握着断剑的手腕，左掌发劲，劈向他面门。

    闵嘉庚转动剑头，当作蛾眉刺使，一闻递招，左手忽地往头顶一拉，取下毡帽，笑着说：“我右手有剑头，左手有盾牌，瞧你奈何得了我？”将毡帽当作盾牌，往他左掌挡去。厉宏生心想：“臭小子，这么一挡，你左腕非断不可。”掌上又加了三分劲道，向破毡帽上直击而下。

    忽听厉宏生啊的一声大叫，向后跃开丈余，这一声叫喊，声音惨厉，竟似受了重伤模样。众人一起望着他，只见他左掌心中鲜血淋漓，不知因何受的伤。厉宏生怒极，戟指闵嘉庚喝问：“你……你……你这烂毡帽中藏着什么？”

    闵嘉庚将毡帽戴回头上，左手中赫然握着一枝金钱镖，笑着说：“这是你万澜集团的暗器，可不是我带来的。有毒无毒，我也不知。我随手在地下捡了一枝，想偷偷拿回去玩儿，你却定要揭穿我底儿，好吧，这一枝小小金钱镖我也不稀罕。”说着提起金钱镖，对准他胸口一扬。

    厉宏生侧过身子，伸手抄出，要将金钱镖抄在手里。他先侧身，再伸手，那是对闵嘉庚已存忌惮之意，怕他发镖的手法又十分怪异，一个抄接不到，不免打中了胸口。岂知他这一伸手却接了个空。闵嘉庚手势是向前发镖，其实手指上使了一股反劲，将金钱镖射向身后。站在他背后的正是温老太，突见金光一闪，镖已到面前，急忙缩头，嚓的一声，金钱镖从她发髻边擦过，随即跌落在地。

    温文新只吓得心惊肉跳，扑到母亲跟前，叫道：“妈，可伤着你么？”

    自闵嘉庚出手以来，几乎每招每式都异想天开，叫人防不胜防，这下花巧异常的发镖，更加眩人心目。眼见温老太在间不容发之际死里逃生，人人尽皆骇然。王万户捻须微笑，心想这般前扬后发的镖法，自己原也擅长，倘若自己出手，就有十个温老太也非打死不可，只是这小孩装模作样的逼真神态，却远非自己所及。

    王万户随即想起，叫道：“快捏住脉门，镖上有毒！”温文新一凛，叫道：“我去取解药！”说着飞奔入内。

    厉宏生掌心一受镖伤，只觉左手麻痒，听王万户这么一叫，右手拉断衣带，紧紧缠住左腕，脸色铁青。厉宏明手足关心，抢过来帮他缠腕。厉宏生左手一甩，喝道：“走开！”厉宏明不提防给他猛力一甩，退开两步，愕然相顾，叫道：“大哥！”厉宏生天生一副执拗的狠劲，当下挥起伤掌，呼的一声，疾往闵嘉庚头顶拍到，脚下飞跑，竟然使出游身八卦掌的绝招，此时再不容情，决意要取这可恶的狡童性命。

    闵嘉庚学成武艺后，初次是与温文新对敌，其后对战温老太和厉宏明，此时与厉宏生对掌，已是第四个对手。越战得久，他心思越开朗，怯意既去，尽力弄巧以补功力之不足。这游身八卦掌曾在厉宏明手下领教过，当时手忙脚乱，险些命丧刀底，此刻已明白其中奥妙所在。晃眼间，厉宏生已转到自己身后，陡然想起秘籍上有一门四象步，步法虽单纯，却似可用，不及细思，见敌人转到身后，立即向前跨了一步。就在这时候，厉宏生呼的一掌，已击向他后心。

    众人见闵嘉庚背后门户洞开，全无防御，不禁为他担心，不料他轻轻巧巧地大步跨前，厉宏生这掌竟尔打空。那游身八卦掌只要一使动，再无停歇，不管出掌是否打中，脚下绝不停留，一掌掌连绵发出。闵嘉庚面向厅门，见厉宏生抢到右边，便向左跨了一步，他脚下跨步，正与厉宏生发掌同时而作，使得这掌又即打空。

    太极生两仪，两仪生四象，四象生八卦，这四象步与八卦掌，其理原有共通之处。《北斗秘籍》上的四象步是练习拳脚器械的入门步法，并不能用以伤敌，闵嘉庚早练得纯熟。斗到后来，他索性双手叉腰，凝神注视对手，也不理厉宏生是否发招，只要他奔到左方，就向右一步，奔到前方，就退后一步。不论对方如何忽前忽后，忽东忽西，他总是好整以暇地前一步、后一步、左一步、右一步，来来去去只是四步，妙在拿捏分寸恰到好处，而这步法又与八卦掌步法的八卦方位丝丝入扣，每一跨步，均与对手的行动若合符节，倒似与厉宏生长期共习，练成了套子一般。

    那游身八卦掌一出手就是连续不断的四八三十二招，厉宏生越打越焦躁，却连手指尖也碰不到闵嘉庚身上。王万户看得暗自叹息：“这人徒学父艺，只知墨守成法，临敌时不能随机应变，另创新意，看来厉士玉是后继无人了。”眼见他第二节的三十二招八卦掌也已使完，温文新取来解药，叫道：“师叔，服了药再收拾那小子。”这时厉宏生的左臂已渐渐不听使唤，知毒气上行，便跃出圈子，接过解药吞服。

    王万户说：“厉兄，我瞧……”厉宏生知他定是出言劝解，待他话一出口，自己若不听从，倒显得不给他面子，当即摇了摇手，抢上前又举掌向闵嘉庚击去。此时他步法极小，出掌也甚凝重，却是使出最厉害的内八卦掌法来。先前厉宏明只虚使内八卦短架，就制得温文新无法动手。厉宏生的功夫又比弟弟精湛得多，这内八卦掌法出手虽短，每掌都极凌厉狠辣。

    闵嘉庚硬接三招，登感不支，暗叫：“糟糕！”见对方步子向左跨出，猛地提脚往他左脚脚背上踩落。厉宏生骂道：“你作死么！”左脚一缩，右脚踏出时就错了八卦方位。厉士玉教子习艺时规定极为严厉，不得有分毫差失，偏生这大儿子又天性固执，临敌时脚下定须踏正方位，才肯出招。待他双脚移正，闵嘉庚又是一脚对准他脚背踩了下去。这般胡闹打法，原是任何成名的英雄所不屑为，闵嘉庚却一味顽皮取闹，连踩几脚，厉宏生心神微乱。闵嘉庚见到有机可乘，猛地一掌往他小腹上击去。厉宏生叫声：“好！”双掌齐出，推在他掌上。

    这是硬碰硬对掌，再无讨巧之处，闵嘉庚全身剧震，左掌跟着力推，但仍感对方压力沉重无比，此时稍一退让，内脏立为对方掌力所伤，只得奋力抵挡。

    王万户见闵嘉庚已然输定，笑着说：“孩子，你输啦，还比拼什么？”伸手在他背上轻轻一拍，一股内力从他身上传过去。厉宏生双臂一酸，胸口微热，忙撤掌后退。王万户说：“厉兄，你功力自比这孩子高得多，那还用比什么？”他轻拍闵嘉庚的肩头，称赞：“了不起，了不起，再过五六年，连我也不是你敌手啦。”言下自然是说你厉宏生更加不用提了。

    厉宏生脸上一热，自知功夫与王万户差得太远，要待交代几句场面话，跟这孩子却又不知从何说起，不由怔在当地，一言不发。厉宏明见兄长的左掌紫黑，中毒甚深，问温老太：“有没有外敷的解毒药？”温老太摇摇头。

    王万户从怀中取出一个红色**，拔开瓶塞，说道：“兄弟自合的解毒药，很有点儿功效。”厉宏明知他是使暗器的大行家，身上不带解毒药则已，倘若携带，定然应验如神。他挂念兄长安危，伸出手掌。王万户在他掌心倒了少许，笑着说：“够用了。”

    这一来，厉氏兄弟无论如何不能再对闵嘉庚留难。
content_en:
It turned out that Min Jiageng knew that he could not defeat him with bare hands, so he took the opportunity to pick up the broken sword and use it as a weapon. However, he was afraid that the other party would use the weapon and provoked him first.How could Li Hongsheng be willing to go hand-to-hand with him even though he knew he would be at a disadvantage? It was expected that it would be useless if he held an extra broken sword, so he just let out a "hum", held the grappling hand in his Bagua palm, and came to grab the wrist holding the broken sword. He used his left palm to strike at his face.
Min Jiageng turned the tip of his sword as if it were an eyebrow thorn. When he heard the move, he suddenly pulled his left hand to the top of his head, took off his felt hat, and said with a smile: "I have a sword point in my right hand and a shield in my left hand. How can you defeat me?" He used the felt hat as a shield and blocked it with his left palm.Li Hongsheng thought to himself: "You brat, if you block like this, your left wrist will be severed." He added another three points of strength to his palm and struck straight down on the worn felt hat.
Suddenly, he heard Li Hongsheng yelling and leaping back more than ten feet. The sound of this yell was tragic and harsh, as if he had been seriously injured.Everyone looked at him and saw that his left palm was dripping with blood, and he was injured for unknown reasons.Li Hongsheng was extremely angry. He pointed his halberd at Min Jiageng and shouted, "You...you...what are you hiding in your rotten felt hat?"
Min Jiageng put his felt hat on his head and held a money dart in his left hand. He said with a smile: "This is the hidden weapon of your Wanlan Group. I did not bring it. I don't know if it is poisonous or not. I picked one up casually on the ground and wanted to take it back for fun, but you insisted on exposing me. Well, I don't care about this little money dart." He raised the money dart and pointed it at his chest.
Li Hongsheng turned sideways, reached out and took out the money dart in his hand.He first turned sideways and then stretched out his hand. This was because he was already wary of Min Jiageng, fearing that his dart technique was very weird and he would not be able to catch the shot and would inevitably hit his chest.Little did he know that when he reached out, he received nothing.Min Jiageng's gesture was to send the dart forward, but in fact he used a counter force on his fingers to shoot the money dart behind him.Standing behind him was Mrs. Wen. Suddenly she saw a flash of golden light and the dart was in front of her. She hurriedly shrank her head. With a sound, the money dart passed by the edge of her bun and fell to the ground.
Wen Wenxin was so frightened that he rushed to his mother and shouted, "Mom, can I hurt you?"
Since Min Jiageng took action, almost every move and style has been whimsical and hard to guard against. This time, the darts are extremely clever and dazzling.Everyone was horrified to see Mrs. Wen narrowly escaping from death.Wang Wanhu twisted his beard and smiled, thinking that he was good at such a forward and backward escort technique. If he took action, there would be ten old ladies Wen who would have to be killed. However, the child's pretending and lifelike demeanor was far beyond his reach.
Wang Wanhu immediately remembered and shouted: "Pinch the pulse door quickly, the dart is poisonous!" Wen Wenxin was shocked and shouted: "I'll get the antidote!" He ran inside.
When Li Hongsheng's palm was injured by the dart, he felt numbness and itching in his left hand. Hearing Wang Wanhu's cry, he pulled off his belt with his right hand and wrapped it tightly around his left wrist, his face turned pale.Li Hongming's brothers were concerned and rushed over to help him wrap his wrist.Li Hongsheng flicked his left hand and shouted: "Go away!" Li Hongming unexpectedly gave him a violent swing, took two steps back, looked at each other in astonishment, and shouted: "Brother!" Li Hongsheng was born with a stubborn and fierce attitude, and immediately raised his injured palm, and with a cry, he rushed towards Min Jiageng's head and hit it.
After Min Jiageng learned martial arts, he faced off against Wen Wenxin for the first time, and then against Mrs. Wen and Li Hongming. At this time, he was facing off against Li Hongsheng, who was his fourth opponent.The longer he fought, the more cheerful his mind became, and his timidity disappeared, and he tried his best to make up for his lack of skill by making up for it with clever tricks.This Youshen Baguazhang had been taught by Li Hongming before. At that time, he was in a hurry and almost died at the end of the knife. Now he understands the secret of it.In the blink of an eye, Li Hongsheng had turned behind him. He suddenly remembered that there was a four-elephant step in the secret book. Although the footwork was simple, it seemed to be useful. Without thinking about it carefully, when he saw the enemy turning behind him, he immediately took a step forward.At this moment, Li Hongsheng's palm hit him in the back of the heart.
When everyone saw that the door behind Min Jiageng was open and defenseless, they couldn't help but worry about him. Unexpectedly, he strode forward lightly and deftly, and Li Hongsheng's palm missed.As long as the Youshen Baguazhang moves, there will be no pause. No matter whether the palm hits or not, the foot will never stop, and the palms will be sent out continuously.Min Jiageng faced the hall door and saw Li Hongsheng grabbing the right, so he took a step to the left. He stepped forward at the same time as Li Hongsheng's palm, causing the palm to hit empty.
Tai Chi generates two rituals, two rituals generate four images, and four elephants generate Bagua. These four elephant steps and Baguazhang have something in common.The Four Elephant Steps in the "Beidou Secret Book" are introductory steps for practicing fists and kicks. They cannot be used to injure the enemy. Min Jiageng has already practiced them proficiently.At the end of the fight, he simply put his hands on his hips and stared at his opponent intently, regardless of whether Li Hongsheng made a move. As long as he ran to the left, he took a step to the right, and when he ran to the front, he took a step back.No matter how the opponent moves forward and backward, east and west, he always takes one step forward, one step back, one step left, and one right right. It is only four steps back and forth. The beauty is that he has just the right balance, and this step is closely related to the Bagua direction of the Baguazhang footwork. If every step is in line with the opponent's movements, it seems that he has practiced with Li Hongsheng for a long time and has developed a set.
As soon as the Youshen Baguazhang was launched, it was a continuous 4832 moves. Li Hongsheng became more and more anxious as he hit, but he couldn't even touch Min Jiageng with his fingertips.Wang Wanhu sighed secretly: "This man just learned his father's skills. He only knows how to stick to the old rules. He can't adapt to the situation and come up with new ideas when facing the enemy. It seems that Li Shiyu has no successor." Seeing his thirty-two moves of gossip in the second quarterHaving finished using his palms, Wen Wenxin took the antidote and shouted: "Uncle Master, take the medicine and then deal with that kid." At this time, Li Hongsheng's left arm gradually lost control. Knowing that the poisonous gas was rising, he jumped out of the circle, took the antidote and swallowed it.
Wang Wanhu said: "Brother Li, let's see..." Li Hongsheng knew that he must be trying to persuade him, but as soon as he said it, if he didn't obey, it would appear that he was not giving him face, so he immediately waved his hand, stepped forward and struck Min Jiageng with his palm.At this time, his steps were extremely small and his palm movements were very solemn, but he was using the most powerful Nei Bagua palm technique.Previously, Li Hongming only used Nei Bagua to make Wen Wenxin unable to take action.Li Hongsheng's kung fu is much more exquisite than his younger brother's. Although the movements of this Bagua palm technique are short, each palm is extremely sharp and cruel.
Min Jiageng took three moves forcefully, feeling overwhelmed and secretly shouting: "Oops!" Seeing the opponent step forward to the left, he suddenly raised his foot and stepped on the instep of his left foot.Li Hongsheng scolded: "Are you seeking death?" He retracted his left foot, and when he stepped out with his right foot, he was in the wrong Bagua position.Li Shiyu had extremely strict rules when teaching his son to learn arts, and no mistakes could be made. However, his eldest son was stubborn by nature. When facing an enemy, he had to keep his feet in the right direction before he was willing to take action.When his feet were straightened, Min Jiageng aimed his foot at his instep and stepped on it.Such a nonsensical style of play is something that any famous hero would disdain, but Min Jiageng just kept being naughty and making trouble, stepping on him several times, and Li Hongsheng was slightly confused.Seeing an opportunity, Min Jiageng suddenly struck him in the abdomen with a palm.Li Hongsheng shouted: "Okay!" Both palms came out and pushed on his palm.
This was a head-to-head palm confrontation, and there was nothing to be flattered about. Min Jiageng's whole body was shaken, and he pushed hard with his left palm, but he still felt the opponent's pressure was extremely heavy. At this time, he gave in a little, and his internal organs were injured by the opponent's palm force, so he had to resist with all his strength.
Seeing that Min Jiageng had already lost, Wang Wanhu said with a smile: "My child, you have lost, why are you still competing?" He reached out and patted him on the back, and an internal force passed through him.Li Hongsheng's arms felt sore and his chest felt slightly hot, so he hurriedly withdrew his palms and retreated.Wang Wanhu said: "Brother Li, your skill is much higher than this kid, so what else do you need to compare with?" He patted Min Jiageng on the shoulder and praised: "It's amazing, it's amazing. In five or six years, even I won't be your rival." The implication was of course that you, Li Hongsheng, let alone Li Hongsheng.
Li Hongsheng's face heated up. He knew that his kung fu was far different from that of Wang Wanhu. He had to explain a few words to the child, but he didn't know where to start. He couldn't help but froze in place and said nothing.Li Hongming saw that his brother's left palm was purple and black, indicating that he was deeply poisoned, so he asked Mrs. Wen: "Is there any external antidote?" Mrs. Wen shook her head.
Wang Wanhu took out a red gun from his arms, uncorked the bottle, and said: "The antidote that the brothers combined together is very effective." Li Hong knew that he was an expert in using concealed weapons, so he didn't have the antidote on him. If he did, it would be like a god.He was concerned about his brother's safety and extended his palm.Wang Wanhu poured a little into his palm and said with a smile, "That's enough."
As a result, the Li brothers could no longer make things difficult for Min Jiageng.
